briefdescription.para: Prepare segment geometry and particle projections for one complete field solve.

detaileddescription.para: This single preparation call eliminates repeated path-only calculations and the second nearest-segment search during gather. It is called by doRunSolver after solve() has put the reference path and every active particle container into the same Cartesian solve frame, and before coverage checking or charge deposition. Two ordered device stages are required: one geometry kernel, followed by a projection kernel for each active container. Geometry must be complete before particles search it; no global inter-block barrier is assumed inside a kernel.

For each non-invalid particle x, search all segments in their original order: \[u_i = clamp((x-R_i)\cdot d_i / |d_i|^2,0,1),\qquad q_i = R_i + u_i d_i. \] The first strictly closest segment is retained, preserving the existing tie rule. Store its index and local coordinates (x_perp,y_perp,s), with $ s=S_i+u_i l_i $. The normal remains the existing (0,1,0), the tangent is d_i/l_i and the binormal is normal cross tangent. This preserves the present path/basis approximation; it introduces no smoothing or curvature correction. Pre-summing S_i changes floating-point association relative to adding preceding lengths to u_i*l_i for every particle; small rounding differences are expected.

The resulting cache is read by open-path coverage checking, deposition and gather in this doRunSolver call. Those stages do not change particle positions, momenta, ordering or the solve frame. Momentum is deliberately not cached: its local components are recomputed by the conversion used for diagnostics. Invalid particles receive a sentinel segment index and are skipped by all consumers. Inactive containers are neither projected nor modified.

simplesect.title: Lifetime and storage
simplesect.para: Recompute geometry and every active particle projection on every complete solve, including after frame changes, particle movement, reordering or count changes. Reuse allocated views when their extents match; otherwise resize them before launching the particle kernel. Storage is O(M + N): 48*M bytes for M segments and (3*sizeof(double)+sizeof(size_t))*N bytes for local particle caches. Buffers of temporarily inactive containers may retain their previous allocation. Views are shared read-only by OpenMP workers; no N-by-M distance matrix exists. The remaining exhaustive search costs O(M*N) work, performed once per solve. Standalone scatterToGrid/gatherFromGrid diagnostic calls default to the uncached conversion, so a later probe edit or exception cannot reuse a stale projection.

parameterdescription.para: Per-call container activity and tracker state.

simplesect.para: The initialized path and particles use the same aligned solve frame.
Inspection-only diagnostic callbacks do not move or reorder particles between preparation and the end of doRunSolver.
Every active non-invalid particle has fresh local coordinates and a nearest-segment index. No particle position, momentum, field or dt is changed.
